page_title: SKAT — High-Voltage Test & Measurement Equipment | IEF SKAT
page_description: Industrial-grade high-voltage testing equipment for power cables, transformer oil, and PPE.
hero_subtitle: From accredited metrology laboratories to energy facilities, petrochemical plants, shipyards, mining, metro and railway systems — SKAT delivers the precision, safety, and reliability that high-voltage engineers trust worldwide.
about_subtitle: IEF SKAT — a full-cycle manufacturer of high-voltage test equipment since 2006.
feature1_desc: IEF SKAT operates a production facility of more than 2000 m² in Volgograd. All hardware and firmware is engineered in-house, ensuring complete control over quality and innovation.
feature2_desc: We maintain our own accredited metrology laboratory. Every unit is rigorously calibrated and verified before shipment, complying with international and EAEU standards.
feature3_desc: Our equipment is engineered with built-in safety interlocks, automatic earthing, and robust overcurrent protection — prioritizing operator safety in high-voltage environments.
feature4_desc: Listed in state registers of Russia, Belarus, and Kazakhstan. With an 18-month warranty and service centers in Volgograd and Minsk, we support you worldwide.

prod_avn70_subtitle: Precision high-voltage load bank (70 kV) for calibrating dielectric testers.
prod_avn70_desc: Designed specifically for the metrological verification and calibration of dielectric testers, the SKAT-AVN-70 active load bank allows technicians to perform accurate validation of voltage and current measurements under load conditions. With 6 independent resistor steps, 40 load combinations, and forced-air cooling, it ensures reliable operation during extended testing.
prod_avn70_feat1_desc: Six independent resistor steps allow for precise simulation of various load conditions, with up to 40 different combinations.
prod_avn70_feat2_desc: Ensures reliable operation and efficient heat dissipation during prolonged testing at high power levels. Turns on automatically at 30 °C.
prod_avn70_feat3_desc: Lightweight and durable construction allows for easy placement in the laboratory or on the test site.
prod_avn70_feat4_desc: All connections are made with special high-voltage wire with high-temperature silicone insulation for safety and reliability.
specs_note: Note: Specifications are subject to change without notice. For custom ranges and configurations, please contact our sales team.

prod_avn70_about1: The SKAT-AVN-70 is a professional active high-voltage load designed specifically for the metrological verification and calibration of dielectric testers (such as SKAT-70, AVID-70, and AID-70 series). This high-power load bank allows technicians to perform accurate validation of voltage and current measurements under load conditions.
prod_avn70_about2: Its mobile dielectric cabinet design ensures strength and lightness, while the automatic forced air cooling system efficiently removes heat generated at the resistor assemblies. All connections between modules are made with special high-voltage wire with high-temperature silicone insulation.
prod_avn70_faq1_q: What equipment is this load compatible with?
prod_avn70_faq1_a: It is designed for SKAT-70, AVID-70, and AID-70 series, among other similar high-voltage test devices.
prod_avn70_faq2_q: What is the maximum power dissipation?
prod_avn70_faq2_a: The total maximum dissipated power is 3750 W, with each step having its own power rating. Maximum continuous operation at full power is 1 hour.
prod_avn70_faq3_a: It features a built-in automatic forced air cooling system. It turns on automatically when the internal temperature reaches 30 °C.
prod_avn70_support1: For detailed guidance on calibration procedures and load testing standards, refer to your equipment's user manual.

prod_kvc_b_desc: Featuring an oil-insulated resistive high-voltage divider, the KVC B-Series delivers exceptional stability and low ratio error for standard industrial frequency measurements. Available in accuracy classes of 0.25%, 0.5%, and 1.0%, these instruments serve as a primary standard for calibrating high-voltage test equipment.

prod_m100v_subtitle: Fully automatic oil breakdown tester for transformer oil (up to 100 kV).
prod_m100v_desc: Meets IEC 60156 and GOST 6581-75, the SKAT-M100V is a dedicated, fully automatic test set designed to measure the dielectric breakdown voltage of transformer oil and other liquid insulants. The unit provides a reliable and standardized method for assessing oil quality.
prod_m100v_feat1_desc: The entire testing process, including voltage ramping and breakdown detection, is fully automated for reliable and repeatable results.
prod_m100v_feat2_desc: Results can be printed directly on-site via the integrated thermal printer, ensuring immediate documentation.
prod_m100v_feat3_desc: High voltage application is automatically blocked when the protective door is open, ensuring operator safety at all times.
prod_m100v_feat4_desc: Choose from 0.5, 1, 2, or 5 kV/s rise rates to match specific test requirements and standards.
prod_m100v_about1: The SKAT-M100V is a dedicated, fully automatic test set designed to measure the dielectric breakdown voltage of transformer oil and other liquid insulants. The unit strictly follows the requirements of IEC 60156 (GOST 6581-75), providing a reliable and standardized method for assessing oil quality.
prod_m100v_about2: The instrument features a fully automated test sequence, a built-in thermal printer for immediate documentation, and a safety door with an interlock system that blocks high voltage application when the lid is open. Operators can select voltage rise rates from 0.5 to 5 kV/s to match specific standards.
prod_m100v_about3: For advanced data management, the SKAT-M100V can be connected to external PC software, allowing for detailed analysis and archiving of test results.
prod_m100v_faq1_a: It measures the dielectric breakdown voltage of transformer oil and other liquid insulants, which indicates the oil's ability to withstand electrical stress.
prod_m100v_faq2_q: Is this test supported by international standards?
prod_m100v_faq2_a: Yes. The instrument is fully compliant with IEC 60156 and GOST 6581-75, which are the primary standards for testing the dielectric strength of insulating liquids.
prod_m100v_faq3_q: Why is measuring breakdown voltage important?
prod_m100v_faq3_a: The breakdown voltage indicates the presence of contaminants, moisture, or particles in the oil. Low breakdown values can lead to transformer failure.

prod_tangens_subtitle: Precision measurement of dielectric loss factor (tan δ) and relative permittivity.
prod_tangens_desc: Fully compliant with IEC 60247 and GOST 6581-75, the SKAT-TANGENS-M is a microprocessor-controlled laboratory instrument designed for the quality control of insulating oils and other liquid dielectrics. It provides fully automatic measurement of tan δ and capacitance with advanced digital harmonic analysis.
prod_tangens_feat1_desc: The entire process, from temperature stabilization to data acquisition and analysis, is fully automated under microcontroller control.
prod_tangens_feat2_desc: Utilizes advanced digital signal processing to ensure high accuracy for tan δ and capacitance measurements.
prod_tangens_feat3_desc: Built-in induction heating allows for rapid and precise temperature control from 40 °C to 110 °C, with a uniformity of ±1 °C.
prod_tangens_feat4_desc: Results can be printed directly via the integrated thermal printer or transferred to a PC via USB for detailed analysis and archiving.
prod_tangens_about1: The SKAT-TANGENS-M is a sophisticated, microprocessor-controlled instrument designed for the precise measurement of the dielectric loss factor (tan δ) and relative permittivity of insulating liquids. It fully complies with the requirements of GOST R IEC 60247-2013 (IEC 60247), ensuring reliable and standardized quality control of transformer oils and other liquid dielectrics used in power equipment.
prod_tangens_about2: The tester utilizes a three-terminal measuring cell made of stainless steel, with a 2 mm gap between electrodes as specified by international standards. The measurement process is fully automatic, employing digital harmonic analysis for high accuracy. The built-in induction heating system allows for precise temperature control from 40 °C to 110 °C, enabling the analysis of temperature-dependent dielectric properties.
prod_tangens_about3: The instrument features a 7" IPS color touchscreen for intuitive operation, internal memory for up to 250 test results, and a built-in thermal printer for immediate documentation. For safety, high voltage application is automatically blocked when the protective lid is open.
prod_tangens_faq1_a: It measures the dielectric loss factor (tan δ) and the capacitance of a test cell filled with insulating liquid. From these, it calculates the relative permittivity (ε) of the liquid.
prod_tangens_faq2_q: Is this test supported by international standards?
prod_tangens_faq2_a: Yes. The instrument is fully compliant with GOST R IEC 60247-2013 (IEC 60247) and GOST 6581-75, which are the primary standards for testing the dielectric properties of insulating liquids.
prod_tangens_faq3_q: Why is measuring Tan δ important for transformer oil?
prod_tangens_faq3_a: The dielectric loss factor (tan δ) indicates the amount of energy lost as heat in the oil. High tan δ values suggest contamination, moisture, or oxidation, which can significantly reduce the oil's insulating properties and lead to transformer failure.

prod_tangens_ts1: The "START" button is not available: Check if the measuring electrode or the coaxial adapter cable is disconnected, or if the protective lid is open.
prod_tangens_ts2: Temperature readings show "----": The temperature sensor may not be connected. Verify the electrode and coaxial cable connections.
prod_tangens_ts3: Error during measurement: Refer to Table 6 in the user manual for error codes. Common issues include foreign objects in the electrode gap (Error 2, 3) or a faulty capacitor (Error 4).

prod_70c_desc: The SKAT-70C and SKAT-100C are advanced digital dielectric testers featuring a high-contrast LCD interface and precise microcontroller-driven regulation. Available in portable and 19" rack-mount configurations, these units deliver reliable high-voltage AC and DC outputs for demanding insulation testing applications.
prod_70c_feat1_desc: Advanced microcontroller-driven regulation ensures precise voltage control and accurate measurements with a resolution of 0.1 kV.
prod_70c_feat2_desc: Clear, high-contrast 6" LCD screen provides real-time monitoring of all test parameters.
prod_70c_feat3_desc: Instantly detects insulation breakdown and safely terminates the test with overcurrent protection.
prod_70c_feat4_desc: Connect external warning lamps for enhanced laboratory safety. Interlock circuit for door detection.
prod_70c_about1: The SKAT-70C and SKAT-100C series represent the next generation of digital dielectric testers. Featuring a user-friendly LCD interface and microcontroller-driven control, these units offer precise regulation and measurement of high-voltage AC and DC outputs for demanding insulation testing applications.
prod_70c_about2: With automatic breakdown detection, overcurrent protection, and a dedicated external safety lamp output, these testers are designed with both performance and operator safety in mind. Multiple form factors are available, including portable and 19" rack-mount configurations, making them suitable for laboratory and field use.

prod_70c_faq1_a: The SKAT-100C offers higher voltage output capability (up to 101 kV DC and 71 kV AC) compared to the SKAT-70C (up to 71 kV DC and 51 kV AC).
prod_70c_faq2_a: Yes, both models are available in a 19" rack-mountable form factor for integration into existing test systems.
prod_70c_faq3_a: The devices include automatic breakdown detection, overcurrent protection, and an external safety lamp output for laboratory warning systems.

prod_70m_subtitle: Robust analog AC/DC test sets (1–71 kV) for field and laboratory use.
prod_70m_desc: Rugged and reliable, the SKAT-70M series is the industry standard for field and laboratory withstanding testing. Available with negative (70M) or positive (70MA) DC polarity, these units generate sinusoidal AC voltage (50 Hz) and regulated DC output for diagnosing insulation in power cables, surge arresters, and personal protective equipment.
prod_70m_feat1_title: Dual Modes: Manual & Automatic Test Sequences
prod_70m_feat1_desc: Choose between precise manual control via the rotary encoder or fully automated test sequences for consistent, repeatable results.
prod_70m_feat2_desc: Set custom test durations with the programmable timer. The unit automatically detects breakdowns, halts the test, and holds the voltage level.
prod_70m_feat3_desc: Separate Control and High-Voltage units, along with an automatic earthing rod and built-in overcurrent protection, ensure maximum safety during high-voltage operations.
prod_70m_feat4_desc: Standard features include overvoltage limitation, transformer overheating protection, and a safety interlock for external laboratory doors.
prod_70m_about1: The SKAT-70M series are robust, high-voltage test sets designed for AC and DC withstand testing. They generate sinusoidal AC voltage (50 Hz) and DC voltage (negative or positive polarity) for diagnosing insulation in power cables, surge arresters, solid dielectrics, and personal protective equipment. This dual functionality makes it an indispensable tool for utility maintenance crews and testing laboratories.
prod_70m_about2: Engineered for reliability, the system features a dual-block design that separates the control and high-voltage sections, significantly enhancing operational safety. The intuitive control panel, featuring a clear LCD display and a precision rotary encoder, provides operators with complete command over test parameters.
prod_70m_about3: The SKAT-70M's automatic test sequences include programmable voltage rise rates, breakdown detection with automatic shutdown, and a robust earthing mechanism that ensures a safe discharge of capacitive loads after testing.
prod_70m_faq1_q: What is the difference between SKAT-70M and SKAT-70MA?
prod_70m_faq1_a: The primary difference is the polarity of the DC output voltage. The SKAT-70M provides a negative polarity DC voltage, while the SKAT-70MA provides a positive polarity DC voltage.
prod_70m_faq2_q: Can I use this for cable testing?
prod_70m_faq2_a: Yes. The SKAT-70M series is perfectly suited for high-voltage withstand testing of power cables, designed to meet the requirements of standards such as IEC 60060.
prod_70m_faq3_a: The system includes automatic earthing rods on the high-voltage block, overcurrent protection, transformer overheat protection, and external interlock capabilities.

prod_70p_feat2_desc: Each channel's leakage current is displayed in real-time on the LCD screen, providing immediate feedback.
prod_70p_feat3_desc: Integrated indicators for HV active, breakdown detection, and test completion.
prod_70p_feat4_desc: Designed for standard HV test sets: SKAT-70M, SKAT-70C, AID-70C, and similar sources.
prod_70p_about1: The SKAT-70P is a specialized measuring attachment designed to work with high-voltage sources to perform leakage current tests on electrical Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). It allows for the testing of up to four items simultaneously, drastically reducing test time.
prod_70p_about2: Its modular design allows for seamless integration with standard high-voltage test sets, making it a versatile and essential tool for any high-voltage safety laboratory. The system includes a test bath, control box, and a full set of interconnection cables.
prod_70p_faq1_q: How many items can be tested at once?
prod_70p_faq1_a: Up to four PPE items can be tested simultaneously, with independent leakage current measurement per channel.
prod_70p_faq2_q: Which HV testers is this compatible with?
prod_70p_faq2_a: The SKAT-70P is designed for use with SKAT-70M, SKAT-70C, and AID-70C series, as well as other high-voltage sources with appropriate control interfaces.
prod_70p_faq3_q: What does the audio-visual signalization indicate?
prod_70p_faq3_a: The system provides clear audio-visual signals for HV Active, Breakdown Detected, and Test Complete, ensuring operator awareness at all times.
prod_70p_support1: For detailed guidance on PPE testing, refer to your equipment's user manual and the following standards:
prod_70p_ts1: No current readings: Check connections and ensure the test bath is properly grounded.
prod_70p_ts2: Inconsistent readings: Verify that the test objects are clean and properly positioned in the bath.
prod_70p_ts3: Communication error: Verify the cable connections between the control box and test bath.
prod_70p_soft: This device does not require software or firmware updates. Contact technical support for any inquiries.
prod_70p_support2: For detailed application notes, technical guides, and academic resources on PPE testing, please refer to the knowledge base on our website or contact our technical support team.
related_70p_desc: 4-channel leakage current attachment for comprehensive PPE testing.
prod_svs_title: SKAT-SVS Series High-Voltage Stationary Test Benches
prod_svs_subtitle: Complete stationary HV test systems for cables, PPE, and insulators.
prod_svs_desc: The SKAT-SVS series are comprehensive, stationary high-voltage test systems designed for acceptance and maintenance testing of power cables, insulators, and PPE (personal protective equipment) such as dielectric boots, gloves, and tools. Available in three configurations with 20 kV to 100 kV modules, these systems offer up to 4-channel leakage current measurement and fully programmable test profiles.
prod_svs_feat1_desc: Simultaneous measurement of leakage current on up to 4 objects for efficient PPE testing.
prod_svs_feat2_desc: Store and recall up to 10 custom test programs with user-defined parameters for repeatable testing.
prod_svs_feat3_desc: Automatically detects breakdown and holds the voltage level for analysis, with immediate shutdown.
prod_svs_feat4_desc: 19" rack-mountable control unit for integration into existing test systems and laboratories.
prod_svs_about1: The SKAT-SVS series are comprehensive, stationary high-voltage test systems designed for a wide range of acceptance and maintenance testing. They are capable of testing power cables, insulators, and PPE (personal protective equipment) such as dielectric boots, gloves, and tools.
prod_svs_about2: The system features 4-channel leakage current measurement, programmable test profiles (10 presets), automatic breakdown detection, and a 19" rack-mountable control unit. Separate HV modules ensure system scalability and flexibility. The test bath is designed for efficient testing of boots, gloves, and insulated tools with up to 4 simultaneous channels.
prod_svs_faq1_q: What is the difference between the three SVS models?
prod_svs_faq1_a: The models differ in the number and type of high-voltage blocks included. SVS-50C includes one 50 kV block, SVS-100C includes two 50 kV blocks, and SVS-100-20C includes one 100 kV and one 20 kV block.
prod_svs_faq2_q: Can I test PPE with this system?
prod_svs_faq2_a: Yes. The system is equipped with a test bath for dielectric boots, gloves, and tools, with 4-channel leakage current measurement.
prod_svs_faq3_a: The system includes automatic earthing rods on all HV blocks, overvoltage and overcurrent protection, and an external interlock connector for laboratory doors.
prod_svs_support1: For detailed guidance on testing procedures and result interpretation, refer to your equipment's user manual and relevant IEC standards.
prod_svs_ts1: Ensure proper grounding: Check high-voltage connections. Verify the test object is correctly positioned.
prod_svs_ts2: Connection error: Check cables between the control unit and HV blocks.
prod_svs_ts3: Overheating: Ensure ventilation is not blocked.
prod_svs_soft: Contact technical support for any software or calibration inquiries.
prod_svs_support2: For detailed application notes, technical guides, and academic resources on high-voltage testing, please refer to the knowledge base on our website or contact our technical support team.
related_svs_desc: Complete stationary HV test systems for cables and PPE.
prod_stend50_subtitle: Test stand for insulating rods and voltage indicators up to 50 kV.
prod_stend50_desc: The SKAT-STEND-50 is a versatile test stand designed specifically for the high-voltage testing of insulating rods, live-line tools, and HV indicators used in substations and transmission lines. Its modular design allows for easy assembly and disassembly, making it ideal for field and laboratory use.
prod_stend50_feat1_desc: Designed for testing insulating rods, live-line tools, and HV indicators up to 50 kV.
prod_stend50_feat2_desc: Allows testing of one object in up to 5 segments, or two objects in up to 2 segments each.
prod_stend50_feat3_desc: Easy assembly and disassembly for transport and storage. Dielectric bases included.
prod_stend50_feat4_desc: Includes high-voltage cables, grounding wires, and 15 temporary electrodes.
prod_stend50_about1: The SKAT-STEND-50 is a versatile test stand designed specifically for the high-voltage testing of insulating rods, live-line tools, and HV indicators used in substations and transmission lines up to 50 kV.
prod_stend50_about2: Its modular design allows for easy assembly and disassembly. The stand supports segmented testing, enabling you to test one object in up to 5 segments or two objects simultaneously in up to 2 segments each. The kit includes dielectric bases for safe object placement, a full set of high-voltage and grounding wires, and 15 temporary electrodes.
prod_stend50_faq1_q: What is the maximum test voltage?
prod_stend50_faq1_a: The stand supports testing up to 50 kV AC. It is designed for insulating rods, live-line tools, and HV indicators used in substations up to 50 kV.
prod_stend50_faq2_q: How many objects can be tested at once?
prod_stend50_faq2_a: The stand supports testing of up to two objects simultaneously. For a single object, you can test up to 5 segments.
prod_stend50_faq3_q: What is included in the kit?
prod_stend50_faq3_a: The kit includes the test table, dielectric bases, high-voltage cables, grounding wires, and 15 temporary electrodes.
prod_stend50_support1: For detailed guidance on testing procedures and result interpretation, refer to your equipment's user manual and relevant IEC standards.
prod_stend50_ts1: Ensure proper grounding: Check high-voltage connections. Verify the test object is correctly positioned.
prod_stend50_ts2: Inconsistent readings: Ensure the test objects are clean and correctly secured.
prod_stend50_soft: This device does not require software or firmware updates. Contact technical support for any inquiries.
prod_stend50_support2: For detailed application notes, technical guides, and academic resources, please refer to the knowledge base on our website or contact our technical support team.
related_stend50_desc: Test stand for insulating rods and voltage indicators up to 50 kV.
prod_ubsvn_subtitle: Safety interlock and audio-visual alarm for HV laboratories.
prod_ubsvn_desc: The UBSVN-LM is a critical safety device designed for high-voltage testing laboratories. It provides a clear audio-visual warning when high voltage is active and physically blocks power to the HV source if the laboratory door is opened, protecting personnel from accidental exposure.
prod_ubsvn_feat1_desc: ≥500 lux contrast perception for clear visibility even in bright environments.
prod_ubsvn_feat2_desc: ≥95 dB sound level at 1 meter distance.
prod_ubsvn_feat3_desc: Open door detection via a normally open limit switch.
prod_ubsvn_about1: The UBSVN-LM is a critical safety device designed for high-voltage testing laboratories. It provides a clear audio-visual warning when high voltage is active and physically blocks power to the HV source if the laboratory door is opened, protecting personnel from accidental exposure.
prod_ubsvn_about2: The device is compatible with SKAT-70M, SKAT-70C, SKAT-70C/100C, SKAT-SVS series, and other HV test equipment with a normally open dry contact interlock circuit. Installation is straightforward, with clear connection diagrams provided in the user manual.
prod_ubsvn_faq1_q: Which devices is this interlock compatible with?
prod_ubsvn_faq1_a: It is compatible with SKAT-70M/70MA, SKAT-70C/100C series, SKAT-SVS series, and other HV sources with a normally open dry contact interlock circuit.
prod_ubsvn_faq2_a: The sound pressure level is at least 95 dB at 1 meter distance.
prod_ubsvn_faq3_q: What is the operating temperature range?
prod_ubsvn_faq3_a: The device operates reliably from -30 °C to +55 °C.
prod_ubsvn_support1: For detailed guidance on installation and troubleshooting, refer to your equipment's user manual.
prod_ubsvn_ts1: Ensure proper wiring: according to the connection diagram. Verify the limit switch is correctly installed on the door. Check the power supply.
prod_ubsvn_ts2: No signal: Check the limit switch connection and power supply.

about_hero_subtitle: Built on engineering integrity. Committed to safety, precision, and the reliability of high-voltage diagnostics.
about_hero_text: From our accredited metrology lab in Volgograd to power grids worldwide, we deliver the testing solutions that industries trust.
about_video_subtitle: From our own R&D bureau to a 2000 m² production hall, we control every step of the process to ensure uncompromising quality.
about_value_text1: At IEF SKAT, we don't just build testing equipment—we build confidence. From the high-voltage lab to the substation, from oil analysis to metrological verification, our instruments provide the critical data engineers need to keep power flowing safely and reliably.
about_value_text2: Our journey began in 2006 with a mission to create high-voltage test solutions that meet the rigorous demands of the energy sector. Today, we are a full-cycle manufacturer with our own accredited metrology laboratory, serving clients across the EAEU, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East.
about_diff1_desc: We design and manufacture our own hardware, software, and firmware, ensuring complete control over quality and innovation.
about_diff2_desc: We maintain our own accredited metrology lab, ensuring every unit is rigorously calibrated and verified before shipment.
about_diff3_desc: Built-in safety interlocks, automatic earthing, and robust overcurrent protection are standard across our product line.
about_diff4_desc: Listed in state registers of Russia, Belarus, and Kazakhstan. Backed by an 18-month warranty and dedicated service centers.
about_global_desc: From our production base in Volgograd to our distributors in Europe, Asia, and the Middle East, we deliver high-voltage testing solutions where they are needed most.
about_global1_desc: Testing and diagnostics for transformers, cable lines, and switchgear.
about_global2_desc: Precision kilovoltmeters and active loads for metrological verification.
about_global3_desc: PPE testing equipment for dielectric gloves, boots, and live-line tools.
support_hero_subtitle: Your equipment's reliability is our highest priority
support_hero_text: We offer a comprehensive range of services worldwide, performed by highly qualified specialists. This includes technical support, delivery of spare parts, regular maintenance, annual calibrations, and repair in the event of faults, as well as training on the use of our devices.
support_hero_text2: Our objective is to provide you with first-class customer service tailored to your individual needs. Contact us to book a service appointment.
support_service1_desc: Direct access to our engineering team for troubleshooting, operation guidance, and technical inquiries.
support_service2_desc: Certified calibration and metrological verification of your equipment to ensure accuracy and compliance with standards.
support_service3_desc: Professional training for dealer personnel and end-users on the operation, maintenance, and safety of SKAT equipment.
support_warranty_note: Free repair during the warranty period, provided operating instructions are followed.
support_centers_note: Multilingual support available in Russian and English.
academy_hero_subtitle: Expert training in high-voltage testing and diagnostics
academy_hero_text: We offer high-quality training courses specially tailored to your individual needs. Whether you are a dealer, a maintenance engineer, or a lab technician — our programs cover the operation, maintenance, and safety of SKAT equipment.
academy_hero_text2: Our course portfolio is constantly expanding. If you have special requirements or suggestions, please let us know — your feedback helps us customise our offer even better.
academy_cta_text: Tell us about your team and what you're looking for — we'll put together a custom program.
applications_hero_subtitle: Delivering confidence across the power industry.
applications_1_desc: Our AC/DC high-voltage test sets (SKAT-70M, SKAT-70C) are engineered for the diagnostic testing and withstand testing of medium and high-voltage power cables.
applications_2_desc: We offer comprehensive solutions for liquid dielectric analysis, from the SKAT-M100V for breakdown voltage testing to the SKAT-TANGENS-M for precision tan δ measurements.
applications_3_desc: Our stationary test benches (SKAT-SVS Series) and test stands (SKAT-STEND-50) are designed for testing insulators, surge arresters, and current transformers.
applications_4_desc: Our SKAT-70P attachment and SKAT-SVS systems allow for the systematic testing of dielectric gloves, boots, and live-line tools.

calibration_hero_subtitle: Measurement accuracy is the foundation of safe, trustworthy diagnostics
calibration_hero_text: Over time, any measuring instrument's readings can drift from reference values. Regular calibration confirms the accuracy of your SKAT equipment and keeps it metrologically reliable throughout its service life.
calibration_process_subtitle: Four steps — from initial check to a document confirming your instrument's accuracy.
calibration_step1_desc: The instrument's readings are compared against reference values to assess its current condition and identify any deviation.
calibration_step2_desc: If the deviation exceeds the allowed tolerance, the instrument is adjusted to bring it back in line with the reference.
calibration_step3_desc: A follow-up measurement confirms that the deviation has been corrected.
calibration_step4_desc: Results are documented, including the method, reference standards used, and the values obtained.
calibration_tier1_desc: Checked against the manufacturer's own reference methods — for routine accuracy checks between formal verifications.
calibration_tier2_desc: Performed by an independent, accredited metrology laboratory — where officially traceable measurement results are required.
calibration_interval_label: Recommended calibration interval for SKAT testing equipment.
calibration_cta_text: Accredited calibration and verification of SKAT equipment is carried out by our partner — an independent metrology laboratory.
